subtasks.description: Declare all registers, wires, and parameters required by datapath and control, and fill the module port list according to S003. Include all named objects from B1 skeleton: text_in_r, sa[0:3][0:3], dcnt, ld_r, done, text_out, subbyte_out, shifted_matrix, mixed_column, next_state, round key words, kld, and FSM state parameters.
constraints: Port list must exactly match S003: clk, rst, ld, done, key, text_in, text_out with correct directions and widths.
Register widths must match S004: text_in_r 128, sa 4x4x8, dcnt 4, ld_r 1, text_out 128, done 1.

subtasks.description: Instantiate aes_key_expand_128 module, connecting all ports as per S014. Use top-level key input, kld from control FSM, and provide wo_0..wo_3 outputs.
constraints: Port connections must adhere to S014 interface: clk, kld, key in, wo_0..wo_3 out (32-bit each).
kld must be driven by the FSM signal generated in B4, and key directly from module input.

subtasks.description: Instantiate 16 parallel aes_sbox units for SubBytes transformation. Each sbox instance gets input a from one byte of the state matrix sa[i][j] and drives output b to subbyte_out[i][j].
constraints: All 16 bytes of the 4x4 state matrix must be mapped to sbox instances using S016 interface (a input, b output).
SubBytes must be purely combinational; no sequential logic inserted.

subtasks.description: Implement sequential FSM with states IDLE, INIT_ROUND, ROUND_OP, FINAL_ROUND, DONE as per S008. Include round counter, load flag, text_in_r buffer, and generate kld for key expansion.
constraints: Sequential FSM: reset to IDLE, on ld transition to INIT_ROUND, then to ROUND_OP, then FINAL_ROUND when dcnt==1, then DONE.
In INIT_ROUND: load text_in_r, set dcnt=0xB, assert kld=1 before next state.
In ROUND_OP: decrement dcnt each cycle; kld must be asserted early enough for key expansion readiness.

subtasks.description: Combinational MixColumns transformation for a single 32-bit column, performing GF(2^8) matrix multiplication as specified in S006.
constraints: Must implement exact GF(2^8) operations (xtime, XOR) as defined by MixColumns matrix in S006.
Output must be purely combinational; no registers or state inside the block.

subtasks.description: Combinational round datapath: perform ShiftRows, use subbyte_out as SubBytes result, apply MixColumns via B5 (skipping when dcnt indicates final round), and AddRoundKey with round key words wo_0..wo_3 to produce next_state matrix.
constraints: Implement ShiftRows per S006 (row shifts 0,1,2,3) on subbyte_out, then MixColumns per B5, bypassing MixColumns when dcnt==1 (final round).
AddRoundKey: XOR each state byte with corresponding byte from round key words wo_0..wo_3 (S014).
Block must be purely combinational; no sequential elements.

subtasks.description: Sequential block that updates the state matrix sa, final text_out, and done signal on clock edges. Implements initial AddRoundKey during INIT_ROUND, round updates in ROUND_OP/FINAL_ROUND, and output/commit in DONE state.
constraints: Update sa: in INIT_ROUND, sa <= text_in_r XOR initial round key; in ROUND_OP/FINAL_ROUND, sa <= next_state.
In DONE state: text_out <= column-major packing of sa; done <= 1.
Registered outputs (sa, text_out, done) must reset to 0 and remain stable after DONE until new load/reset.
